description: Shared update policy for repos built with agentic_development's templates (docs/intent/renovate-preset/renovate-preset-design.md).

packageRules.description: LID plugin pins need a manual /update-lid walk on the update's branch before merging.
Copier template versions have no release timestamps, so the delay can't apply.
Runner images come from a list inside Renovate, with no release timestamps.
This system's own releases (agentic_development and copier-<lowercase language> templates) skip the delay.
